description: This file defines a class 'HTTP_Request' for performing HTTP requests, including methods for setting request parameters, headers, handling redirects, and processing responses. It also includes the 'HTTP_Response' class to process and interpret HTTP responses, managing headers, cookies, gzip decoding, and chunked transfer encoding. The file references external PEAR classes for error handling and socket/url communication.

classes.name: HTTP_Request
classes.description: Class for constructing, sending, and managing HTTP requests, supporting various methods, headers, proxies, redirects, and file uploads.

classes.name: HTTP_Response
classes.description: Class for processing HTTP responses, extracting status codes, headers, cookies, decoding gzip and chunked encoding, and providing response data.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Performs the HTTP request, handles redirects, and processes the response.

methods.name: setURL
methods.description: Sets the URL for the request.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Configures a proxy server for the request.

methods.name: addHeader
methods.description: Adds a custom header to the request.

methods.name: getResponseCode
methods.description: Returns the HTTP response status code.

methods.name: getResponseHeader
methods.description: Retrieves specific or all response headers.
